# AutoDE skills

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:generate` from skills/, agents/ and skills/external.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every skill AutoDE has, the interview packs, and the vendor and community skills it works with. In a workspace, `autode skills list` (CLI), `autode_skills_list` (MCP) and the Skills view (VS Code) show the same catalog plus the team's own imported skills, and whether each external skill is installed on this machine.

## AutoDE skills

Named `autode-<scope>-<capability>` (scopes: `core`, `de`, `snowflake`, `databricks`, `oracle`, `dbt`). Each declares its stage kinds and platforms in its `metadata`; a stage gets the skills for its kind and the problem's target platform.

| Skill | Scope | Stage kinds | Platforms | Version | Maturity | Used by | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `autode-core-document-reading` | core | — | any | 1 | tested | context-curator | Read the documents in an AutoDE business problem's pack (BRDs, KPI definitions, data contracts, data dictionaries) into proposed facts that cite their section, and propose reading profiles for structured documents in a house format, for a person to confirm. Use it when the user adds a document to the pack or asks what a document says. |
| `autode-core-fact-extraction` | core | — | any | 1 | tested | context-curator | Turn what the user states about their data and business while working with you (keys, grain, relationships, terms, metrics, rules, decisions, assumptions, constraints) into facts proposed to AutoDE, with the message as evidence, for a person to confirm. Use it after any message in which the user says something true about their data, systems or rules, in an AutoDE workspace. |
| `autode-core-glossary-structure` | core | — | any | 1 | preview | knowledge-engineer | Structure AutoDE's business glossary as SKOS concepts - place each term in a category, link broader, narrower and related terms, name its steward and status, and bind it to the columns it describes - as corrections a person confirms in the Context Inbox. Use it when terms fit no category, when the glossary has grown unorganised, or when a maintenance item names the knowledge engineer for the glossary. |
| `autode-core-knowledge-articles` | core | — | any | 1 | preview | knowledge-engineer | Write and maintain AutoDE knowledge articles - Markdown pages about assets, terms or domains that say what atomic facts can't (pitfalls, history, golden sources, how to reconcile), citing every fact they rest on - and update an article when a fact it cites is superseded or rejected. Use it when an asset needs explaining beyond its facts, or when a maintenance item says an article is stale. |
| `autode-core-knowledge-maintenance` | core | — | any | 1 | preview | context-curator, knowledge-engineer, semantic-modeler | Work AutoDE's knowledge-maintenance queue - the items its deterministic rules raise when a confirmed fact contradicts a semantic model, a cited fact changes an article, a document hasn't been read for knowledge, chat turns that read like facts haven't been reviewed, or a stage's deliverable went stale - one item at a time, as proposals a person approves. Use it when asked to keep AutoDE's knowledge current, at the start or end of a stage, or when an item names your role. |
| `autode-core-orchestrator` | core | — | any | 3 | tested | — | Run an AutoDE business problem's workflow in this host - find the next stage, have the right agent do it, hand it in, and tell the user what needs their approval. Use it when the user asks to work on, continue, or check progress of an AutoDE problem. |
| `autode-core-semantic-modeling` | core | — | any | 1 | preview | semantic-modeler | Draft, refine and repair AutoDE's shared semantic models (Snowflake semantic model YAML) from confirmed facts - tables and keys, relationships, dimensions, facts, metrics, synonyms, verified queries, kpi tags - resolve ambiguous base tables, bind models to their system, and propose each change for a person to approve. Use it when a semantic model is to be created, when a maintenance item names the semantic modeler, or when a metric, join or term has no counterpart in the layer. |

## External skills (references only)

Skills from vendors and the community that AutoDE works with. AutoDE does not copy or ship them: their licences are below. When one is installed in a host, AutoDE names it in the assignments of the stages it helps with. When it isn't, AutoDE can offer the vendor's own install command (probed first, run only on a click). Correct or add entries in `.autode/config/external-skills.yaml`.

### Installing

- **Databricks agent skills:** `databricks aitools install` (needs databricks 1.0.0+); last verified 2026-10-22 (against the vendor's README (the command was not run by AutoDE's CI yet)). Vendor docs: https://github.com/databricks/databricks-agent-skills.
  - claude: In Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add databricks/databricks-agent-skills, then /plugin install databricks@databricks-agent-skills
  - copilot: copilot plugin marketplace add databricks/databricks-agent-skills, then copilot plugin install databricks@databricks-agent-skills

### Licences

- **Databricks License** ([text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/databricks/databricks-agent-skills/main/LICENSE)): Use only in connection with Databricks Services; modified files must say so; Databricks may end the licence on notice, after which copies must be deleted. AutoDE references these skills and never ships them.
- **Part of Snowflake Cortex Code** ([text](https://www.snowflake.com/en/product/snowflake-coco/)): Built into Cortex Code and available only inside it.
- **Per skill (Apache-2.0 for community contributions, a Snowflake licence for Snowflake employees' contributions)** ([text](https://github.com/Snowflake-Labs/coco-skills)): Each skill carries its own LICENSE file; check it before importing. Snowflake does not guarantee these skills' correctness.
